title: Predication settling category
description: JSON Schema for the predication-settling category PS(L, C, E, λ) — a thin poset-category whose objects are predication-settlings over a fixed base and whose hom-classes are sub-singletons indexed by the pointwise-and-stepwise knowledge-order relation on valuations. Stored as the base parameters and the list of object-settlings; the homs are reconstructed by a script from the ≤_k relation and are not stored. The antisymmetric-poset property is runtime-checked.

settlings.description: The objects of the category — settlings over the fixed base (L, C, E, λ).
